subject: Case ownership follows test_plan: worker writes only the contracts test_plan assigns to the worker, verifier only those assigned to the verifier; implementer card, DISPATCH-TEMPLATE §1, verifier card and auto-fix packet text say so
objective: Reviewer sent back four complex tickets in a row for worker/verifier duplicate cases in the same layer (#157, #161, #169, #119; see tickets/169.json reviewer objection 'verifier patch-verify duplicates the worker's A1-A4 cases' and the 'dedupe round'), each costing an extra worker round to delete cases plus a gate and review rerun. Root cause: test_plan already names an owner (worker or verifier) per contract, but memory/role/implementer.md line 8 still says the deliverable includes '**自己的單元測試**' with no reference to that assignment, so the worker writes the verifier's contracts too. After this ticket the rule has one body (D-054 Q12) in docs/DISPATCH-TEMPLATE.md §1 next to the '只准跑的測試' paragraph: worker writes cases only for contracts test_plan assigns to the worker; contracts assigned to the verifier it does not write; contracts test_plan leaves unassigned (or no test_plan) the worker judges itself. Verifier symmetric: writes only contracts assigned to the verifier (unassigned -> per acceptance as today). Cards (implementer.md '交付物' sentence, verifier.md '做' sentence) carry a one-clause pointer, not a second body. scripts/auto-fix.sh only_tests_section() appends one role-specific line right after the verbatim test_plan under '## 票的測試計畫' (only when test_plan is non-empty), so the packet itself says it. Not here: batch packet (auto-fix.sh ~2879, red-list only, no test_plan), reviewer card (already rejects duplicates), docs/VISION.md line 68 (user's quote, stays), docs/FLOW.html (already stale), gate/land behaviour.
acceptance:
A1 worker packet (tests/test_auto_fix.py class ThePacketSaysWhichTestsToRun, existing harness, ticket with test_plan set, 'auto-fix.sh <n> --dry-run --round 1'): in dispatch-round1.md the '## 票的測試計畫' section is the test_plan verbatim followed by exactly the line '寫案例只寫 test_plan 指給 worker 的契約;指給驗證者的不寫(驗證者會寫,重複會被覆核退回);沒指派的才自己判。' (existing assertIn('
## 票的測試計畫
'+PLAN+'
') stays green). '## 只准跑的測試' unchanged (still exactly three lines).

A2 verifier packet (same test): dispatch-verifier-round1.md '## 票的測試計畫' ends with exactly '寫案例只寫 test_plan 指給驗證者的契約;指給 worker 的不寫(worker 會寫,重複會被覆核退回)。' and does not contain the worker line; worker packet does not contain the verifier line. Ticket without test_plan: neither line appears in either packet (section still says '票沒有 test_plan'). Mutation (not measured by opener): drop the worker print -> A1 red.

A3 rule text (static assertions in tests/test_auto_fix.py or tests/test_templates.py reading committed files): docs/DISPATCH-TEMPLATE.md §1 contains a sentence with 'test_plan', '指給 worker', '指給驗證者' and '沒指派'; memory/role/implementer.md '交付物' sentence contains 'test_plan 指給 worker'; memory/role/verifier.md contains 'test_plan 指給驗證者'.

A4 old wording gone: grep -c '自己的單元測試' memory/role/implementer.md docs/ROLES.md == 0 for both files (ROLES.md line 12 deliverable cell reworded to the same ownership rule); 'python3 scripts/rules.py pack worker' and 'pack verifier' rc 0 (section titles intact); 'python3 scripts/memory.py check' reports no over-cap for implementer.md / verifier.md.
A5 existing suites green: the gate's branch map for this ticket and the full suite at land (worker runs only its packet's 只准跑 lines, per §1).
test_plan: All contracts (A1-A4) are worker's: extend ThePacketSaysWhichTestsToRun in tests/test_auto_fix.py (packet lines; expected strings hard-coded from this ticket, not read from auto-fix.sh) and add static file assertions there or in tests/test_templates.py. No verifier cases (needs_verifier false). A5 is the gate/land, not a case.
outline:
Fix the worker/verifier duplicate-case reject loop (#157 #161 #169 #119). Order: (1) DISPATCH-TEMPLATE §1 one-body ownership sentence; (2) implementer.md 交付物 + verifier.md 做 pointers, ROLES.md:12 cell; (3) auto-fix.sh only_tests_section() print after plan; (4) tests. Files that move: docs/DISPATCH-TEMPLATE.md, memory/role/implementer.md, memory/role/verifier.md, docs/ROLES.md, scripts/auto-fix.sh, tests/test_auto_fix.py. Measured at 727fd9a: test_auto_fix.py:3521/3529 assert '
## 票的測試計畫
'+PLAN+'
' - appending after plan keeps them green; 3545 checks '票沒有 test_plan'. Shape is post-#168 (landed). #173 touches tests/test_adapter_unittest.py etc, not these files. needs_verifier=false: packet string contract, verifier would only replay the worker's assertions. hard_block: no added os.kill/killpg/pkill/kill - lines. simple.
